# `tabs`

Helper: `tabs(items, activeIndex, { seg })`  
Kit (`src/ui`): `Tabs` (`tabs.tsx`) · status: src/ui  
App (KMP `core:ui`): none

## Anatomy

Bar of items; each item: label, optional count; active item has a 2px underline in link colour and 700 weight.

## Variants

- Underline bar (default)
- `seg`: segmented control (Ngày / 7 ngày), pills inside a tile-coloured track

## States

- Active: link colour, 700, underline
- Inactive: ink-soft
- Keyboard: arrow keys, Home, End (kit)

## Tokens

link, ink-soft, line, tile, surface, shadow-card (active segment)

## Do

- Use for views of the same object (Patient 360)
- Keep labels to one or two words; give a `shortLabel` for 390

## Don't

- Do not use tabs for filters (chips) or for steps of a flow

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Underline bar, items 40px high, left aligned.

## Mobile (390)

Becomes a segmented control of equal pills with short labels; the active pill is raised (surface, shadow-card).

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Underline bar; `seg` = segmented control (Ngày / 7 ngày). Item `'label'` or `[label, count]`. 390: equal pills
